paragraphs: Mentioned in [Moed Katan 11a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.11a.18): "Rav happened to come to the house of Rav Shafir"; Dikdukei Soferim reads "Bar Shafir."[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage names Rav Shafir as Rav’s host. Hyman reports the alternate form Bar Shafir from Dikdukei Soferim.
